reasoning: 驗證目標：GameZone 下未選取任何主隊時，不發起 game alert。為什麼這樣切：條款是抑制規則，其判準必須以「確有比賽正在播出」構造，否則沒有比賽時的靜默也會通過——那不足以證明抑制生效。故前置條件要求多場比賽同時進行且最愛清單為空，ER 斷言全程無提示，並在末步確認清單確實為空以排除設定未生效的偽陰性。

tcs.tc_title: No game alert is raised while the GameZone favorites list is empty
tcs.test_item: If no teams were selected as Favorite under GameZone, the HU shall not initiate game alerts
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. No team is set as a GameZone favorite
5. At least two games are in progress and at least one of them starts during the test
6. A score change occurs in one of the games during the test
7. Game alerts are enabled
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the GameZone favorites list
2. Leave the HU untouched until the further game starts, then read the HU screen
3. Wait until a score change occurs, then read the HU screen
4. Read the GameZone favorites list
tcs.expected_result:
1. The GameZone favorites list holds no team
2. No game alert is presented
3. No game alert is presented
4. The GameZone favorites list still holds no team
